title: Project registry
description: Reference contract for factory/projects.json. Runtime validation is factory/lib/intel/schema.mjs.

key.description: Stable project key; matches the task contract's `project` field.

repo.description: '.', '~/path', an absolute path, or a path relative to the HQ repo root.

contextDir.description: Repo-relative directory holding the canonical context files. No leading '/', no '..' segment. Default 'context'.

mission.description: One-line project mission. A convenience mirror of context/MISSION.md / ownership.json for the company view.

owner.description: Who owns this project's direction. Usually 'founder'.

github.description: GitHub coordinates for read-only external awareness.

responsibleAgents.description: Agent ids (from factory/agents.json) currently responsible for this project.
